# ScripticX

> ScripticX is a Romanian organization from Brăila, founded in February 2026 by Andrei Lascu. It has three parts: the Education Center (informatics and machine learning programs, free workshops), ScripticX Development (websites and apps for clients, with a dedicated client portal), and the ScripticX Platform (a learning workspace built around the MiniScript+ language).

The website is available in English (/en) and Romanian (/ro).

## About

- [About ScripticX](https://www.scripticx.org/en/about): what ScripticX is, its divisions, events, partners and team
- [Team](https://www.scripticx.org/en#team): the people behind ScripticX

## Education

- [Education Center](https://www.scripticx.org/en/education): informatics and machine learning programs, individual and group mentorship, contest preparation
- [Events and workshops](https://www.scripticx.org/en/events): free workshops and courses in Brăila and online competitions
- [Free lessons on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@ScripticXLessons): free programming lessons

## Development

- [ScripticX Development](https://www.scripticx.org/en/development): product direction, websites, web and mobile apps, and maintenance for clients. Every client gets a dedicated client portal for updates, approvals, files, contracts and invoices.

## Platform

- [ScripticX Platform](https://www.scripticx.org/en/platform): lessons, programming problems, projects and classes in one browser workspace; supports MiniScript+, C++ and Python
- [Open the platform](https://platform.scripticx.org)
- [MiniScript+ basics](https://www.scripticx.org/en/docs/miniscript): the beginner-friendly language used on ScripticX

## More

- [Partners and sponsors](https://www.scripticx.org/en/partners)
- [Knowledge Center](https://www.scripticx.org/en/knowledge)
- [Blog](https://www.scripticx.org/en/blog)
